parole.significato: A cloak or gown, especially of a kind popular with women in the 17th and 18th centuries.
parole.testo: Borrowed from French manteau (“mantle”). In the Iranian context, borrowed from Persian مانتو (mânto), originating in the Qajar period. Doublet of mantle and mantel.
